angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,122,234 km at 80.13 pc = 0.19 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.4791 +/- 0.0268 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 80.13 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.6131 +/- 0.0292 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1898 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 1,122,234 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.2484 +/- 0.0261 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1898 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6241 +/- 88 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1898 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1898 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1898.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.119, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1898 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.095 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1898 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.55121, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1898 (pscomppars): age 3.1 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, HD 83342: projected rotation speed 7.44 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2024ApJ...968L...2L)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
